notes.title: The UI interface of Soda scuffle has received an update!
notes.content: After a seven-month wait, Soda scuffle has finally received its first UI update, which is truly exciting news. In the near future, Soda scuffle will undergo further UI updates!

notes.title: Fix a known bug
notes.content: After obtaining the shield for the first time, the shield will not be deducted immediately when damaged, but will only be deducted after the second injury.
